data.name: NotMigratedTitle
data.value: This settings page has not been migrated to WinUI yet

data.name: NotMigratedBody
data.value: The WinUI editor window and its lifecycle are in place, but this built-in page has not been rebuilt on WinUI yet. The previous Avalonia page is deliberately not shown here, so an unmigrated page can never look finished. The previous page type is listed below for tracking.

data.name: NeedsAdapterTitle
data.value: This plugin editor needs a WinUI page

data.name: NeedsAdapterBody
data.value: The widget still loads and runs, but it only ships a previous-generation Avalonia settings page, which the WinUI editor cannot host. The plugin can register a WinUI page factory in the editor registry to make its settings editable again.

data.name: PageUnavailableTitle
data.value: This editor page could not be created
